hotspots.label: A puddle in a flat cap

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: The Ember Arms. Apartment Nine. The door was warm. The doorknob was warmer. I knocked anyway.
lines.spoken: The Ember Arms. -- Apartment Nine. -- The door was warm. -- The doorknob was warmer. ---- I knocked anyway.

lines.speaker: comet
lines.text: Well, look who it is. Come on in, sugar. Mind the puddles.
lines.spoken: Well, look who it is. - Come on in, sugar. --- Mind the puddles.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: It was ninety degrees in there. My mustache was sweating, and I don't have a mustache.
lines.spoken: It was ninety degrees in there. --- My mustache was sweating, and I don't have a mustache.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Found your gym bag, ma'am. Purely professional.
lines.spoken: Found your gym bag, ma'am. --- Purely professional.

lines.speaker: comet
lines.text: My hero. Make yourself at home. Take your coat off. You'll want to.
lines.spoken: My hero. - Make yourself at home. - Take your coat off. --- You'll want to.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: I kept my coat on. A detective's coat is his armor. Also it was the only thing keeping me from being a puddle.
lines.spoken: I kept my coat on. -- A detective's coat is his armor. ---- Also it was the only thing keeping me from being a puddle.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Puddles. In every corner. Under every chair. One of them was wearing a mitten.
lines.spoken: Puddles. -- In every corner. -- Under every chair. ---- One of them was wearing a mitten.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Leaky radiator, probably. Old building. These things happen.
lines.spoken: Leaky radiator, probably. -- Old building. ---- These things happen.

lines.speaker: comet
lines.text: Oh, don't mind that. It's decorative.
lines.spoken: Oh, don't mind that. - It's decorative.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: It was bubbling. It was steaming. A rubber duck floated in it, belly up.
lines.spoken: It was bubbling. -- It was steaming. ---- A rubber duck floated in it, belly up.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Decorative. Sure. I've seen stranger things in a dame's living room. Not many.
lines.spoken: Decorative. -- Sure. -- I've seen stranger things in a dame's living room. ---- Not many.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: A door at the back stood half open. Behind it, something glinted. Something hat-shaped.
lines.spoken: A door at the back stood half open. -- Behind it, something glinted. ---- Something hat-shaped.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: The back room. Candles everywhere. And on every wall, every shelf, every surface: top hats. Scarves. Carrots.
lines.spoken: The back room. -- Candles everywhere. -- And on every wall, every shelf, every surface: top hats. -- Scarves. ---- Carrots.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Dozens of them. Lined up neat. Labeled with dates.
lines.spoken: Dozens of them. -- Lined up neat. ---- Labeled with dates.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: A collector. Some dames collect stamps. Some collect spoons. This one collected snowman accessories.
lines.spoken: A collector. -- Some dames collect stamps. -- Some collect spoons. ---- This one collected snowman accessories.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Harmless hobby. Everybody needs one. Mine is solving crimes, very slowly.
lines.spoken: Harmless hobby. -- Everybody needs one. ---- Mine is solving crimes, very slowly.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: In the corner, a fresh puddle. A flat cap floating in it. An oversized scarf, soaking wet.
lines.spoken: In the corner, a fresh puddle. -- A flat cap floating in it. ---- An oversized scarf, soaking wet.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Somebody had left their winter clothes in the wet. Kids today. No respect for knitwear.
lines.spoken: Somebody had left their winter clothes in the wet. -- Kids today. ---- No respect for knitwear.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Through the tinsel goggles, the mirror lit up like a pinball machine.
lines.spoken: Through the tinsel goggles, the mirror lit up like a pinball machine.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Lipstick kisses. Dozens of them. Each one scorched right into the glass.
lines.spoken: Lipstick kisses. -- Dozens of them. ---- Each one scorched right into the glass.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: She must really like mirrors. Or herself. Or both. I wasn't here to judge. I was here to return a gym bag.
lines.spoken: She must really like mirrors. -- Or herself. -- Or both. -- I wasn't here to judge. ---- I was here to return a gym bag.

lines.speaker: comet
lines.text: Need a lift, sugar? Up you go.
lines.spoken: Need a lift, sugar? - Up you go.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: She lifted me toward the top shelf. My coat started smoking. I told myself it was a style choice.
lines.spoken: She lifted me toward the top shelf. -- My coat started smoking. ---- I told myself it was a style choice.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: A scrapbook. Leather. Warm to the touch. I opened it.
lines.spoken: A scrapbook. -- Leather. -- Warm to the touch. ---- I opened it.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Page one. A snowman in a bow tie, 1938. Page two. A puddle, in a bow tie.
lines.spoken: Page one. -- A snowman in a bow tie, 1938. -- Page two. ---- A puddle, in a bow tie.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Page three. A snowman in a sailor hat. Page four. A puddle, in a sailor hat.
lines.spoken: Page three. -- A snowman in a sailor hat. -- Page four. ---- A puddle, in a sailor hat.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: The last page. Jimmy Mittens, smiling, last night. And next to it, a blank space. Waiting.
lines.spoken: The last page. -- Jimmy Mittens, smiling, last night. -- And next to it, a blank space. ---- Waiting.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: And then it hit me. Not like a sleigh. Like the whole team.
lines.spoken: And then it hit me. -- Not like a sleigh. ---- Like the whole team.

lines.speaker: comet
lines.text: I've got a sleigh to catch, sugar. Roof's this way.
lines.spoken: I've got a sleigh to catch, sugar. - Roof's this way.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: She went up the fire escape. I followed. It took a while. The steps were very far apart.
lines.spoken: She went up the fire escape. -- I followed. -- It took a while. ---- The steps were very far apart.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: The roof of the Ember Arms. Snow coming down, stars coming out, and the whole North Pole glittering below.
lines.spoken: The roof of the Ember Arms. --- Snow coming down, stars coming out, and the whole North Pole glittering below.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: Detective! Wait! I came as fast as I could! I took the bus!
lines.spoken: Detective! - Wait! - I came as fast as I could! --- I took the bus!

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Granny Slush. Right on time. Every great reveal needs an audience. Mine had two.
lines.spoken: Granny Slush. -- Right on time. -- Every great reveal needs an audience. ---- Mine had two.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Ladies. Reindeer. Gather round.
lines.spoken: Ladies. -- Reindeer. ---- Gather round.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Jimmy Mittens didn't slip in that alley. He didn't wander off. He didn't take an early spring.
lines.spoken: Jimmy Mittens didn't slip in that alley. -- He didn't wander off. ---- He didn't take an early spring.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: He was melted.
lines.spoken: He was melted.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: I know. Take a minute. I'll wait.
lines.spoken: I know. -- Take a minute. ---- I'll wait.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Exhibit A. A puddle. Snowmen don't just turn into puddles. Not without heat. A great deal of heat.
lines.spoken: Exhibit A. -- A puddle. -- Snowmen don't just turn into puddles. -- Not without heat. ---- A great deal of heat.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Exhibit B. Scorch marks. Shaped like hooves. Four of them. Which, if you count, is exactly how many hooves a reindeer has.
lines.spoken: Exhibit B. -- Scorch marks. -- Shaped like hooves. -- Four of them. ---- Which, if you count, is exactly how many hooves a reindeer has.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Exhibit C. A lipstick kiss, still smoking, at exactly snowman-head height.
lines.spoken: Exhibit C. --- A lipstick kiss, still smoking, at exactly snowman-head height.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Exhibit D. A reserved card. 'J. Mittens, plus C.' Exhibit E. A gym bag. 'Return to C.' Exhibit F. This building. Where C lives.
lines.spoken: Exhibit D. -- A reserved card. -- 'J. -- Mittens, plus C.' Exhibit E. -- A gym bag. -- 'Return to C.' Exhibit F. -- This building. ---- Where C lives.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: And Exhibit G. The killer's hooves. They are, and I cannot stress this enough, on fire.
lines.spoken: And Exhibit G. -- The killer's hooves. ---- They are, and I cannot stress this enough, on fire.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: The killer is someone hot. Someone fast. Someone whose name starts with C and ends with 'omet.'
lines.spoken: The killer is someone hot. -- Someone fast. ---- Someone whose name starts with C and ends with 'omet.'

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: The killer is you. Comet.
lines.spoken: The killer is you. --- Comet.

lines.speaker: comet
lines.text: Took you long enough, sugar.
lines.spoken: Took you long enough, sugar.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: It took me all night, a bus ride, and a carrot cartel. But I got there.
lines.spoken: It took me all night, a bus ride, and a carrot cartel. --- But I got there.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: My Jimmy? With her? Oh, I told him. I told him he had a snowball's chance in hell.
lines.spoken: My Jimmy? - With her? - Oh, I told him. --- I told him he had a snowball's chance in hell.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: Oh. Oh, I see it now.
lines.spoken: Oh. - Oh, I see it now.

lines.speaker: comet
lines.text: He was sweet, Granny. They're all sweet. Then they get a little soft around the edges.
lines.spoken: He was sweet, Granny. - They're all sweet. --- Then they get a little soft around the edges.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Case closed. Or so I thought. Then a shadow fell across the roof. A very large shadow. With antlers.
lines.spoken: Case closed. -- Or so I thought. -- Then a shadow fell across the roof. -- A very large shadow. ---- With antlers.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: A sleigh came down out of the clouds and landed on the roof like it owned the place. Which, technically, it did.
lines.spoken: A sleigh came down out of the clouds and landed on the roof like it owned the place. --- Which, technically, it did.

lines.speaker: santa
lines.text: Ho. Ho. Ho.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Santa Claus. The big man. The boss of the whole North Pole. In person, and in a very nice suit.
lines.spoken: Santa Claus. -- The big man. -- The boss of the whole North Pole. ---- In person, and in a very nice suit.

lines.speaker: santa
lines.text: Good work, detective. I know. I have always known.
lines.spoken: Good work, detective. -- I know. ---- I have always known.

lines.speaker: santa
lines.text: I see you when you're sleeping. I know when you're awake. I knew when Jimmy Mittens sat down beside a reindeer whose feet were on fire.
lines.spoken: I see you when you're sleeping. -- I know when you're awake. ---- I knew when Jimmy Mittens sat down beside a reindeer whose feet were on fire.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: You knew? The whole time?
lines.spoken: You knew? --- The whole time?

lines.speaker: santa
lines.text: I keep a list. I check it twice. Comet has been on it, in red ink, since 1938.
lines.spoken: I keep a list. -- I check it twice. ---- Comet has been on it, in red ink, since 1938.

lines.speaker: santa
lines.text: And yet, it is Christmas Eve. And she is the warmest thing in the sky.
lines.spoken: And yet, it is Christmas Eve. --- And she is the warmest thing in the sky.

lines.speaker: santa
lines.text: Comet. Harness. Front left.
lines.spoken: Comet. -- Harness. ---- Front left.

lines.speaker: comet
lines.text: Yes, boss.
lines.spoken: Yes, boss.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Just like that, she was hitched to the sleigh. Front left. Somewhere, Donner and Blitzen felt a disturbance.
lines.spoken: Just like that, she was hitched to the sleigh. -- Front left. ---- Somewhere, Donner and Blitzen felt a disturbance.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: Well. You found him, dear. Most of him.
lines.spoken: Well. - You found him, dear. --- Most of him.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: I looked up at the big man. Way, way up. It's the only direction I know.
lines.spoken: I looked up at the big man. -- Way, way up. ---- It's the only direction I know.

lines.speaker: santa
lines.text: Merry Christmas, Tiny Hightower. Be good. I'll know.
lines.spoken: Merry Christmas, Tiny Hightower. -- Be good. ---- I'll know.
